There is a free-flowing movement from Iyana Dopemu, underneath the bridge, heading inward toward the M.O.J. filling station. However, movement becomes busy as vehicles approach Bolade Junction due to a backlog extending from Brown Junction.

The return journey from Bolade Intersection back to Iyana Dopemu is currently smooth and without delays. Similarly, traffic along Ile-Zik connecting to Sule Junction remains calm at the moment.

There are no visible obstructions or impediments in these areas, and our officers are on ground, actively managing the situation and ensuring order.

#FollowLASTMA

Motorists can expect good movement from the Agbara Customs Checkpoint to Iyana Era, and through Iyana Ishasi. The stretch from Afromedia to Iyana Iba is experiencing a smooth ride.

There is uninterrupted vehicular movement atop the Iyana Iba flyover heading inward Mile 2, with good movement maintained under the flyover inward Igando. Additionally, traffic is flowing freely from Volks down to Barracks. The routes connecting Barracks to Abule Osun, Trade Fair, and Abule Ado are also clear.

Overall, there are no reported impediments within these areas, and our personnel are on site, ensuring continued smooth operations.
